The goal of the PULSE-Mime project was to capture and protect a large area.

Second, the Pokémon's free will is suppressed.
Stolen Pokémon, for example, may be controlled without fail this way.
Many high ranking Meteors have treated their Pokémon with PULSE2s by now.
Please prepare accordingly.
